senses.gloss: f. (חָפַף II) cleansing the head with a detergent, comb &c.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 82b:1">B. Kam. 82ᵇ</cite> top. <he>תיקן ח׳</he> ordained (for women before bathing) cleansing &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 2:2:1">Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 2:1">Tosef. Maas. Sh. II, 1</cite> <he>חֲפִיפָתָהּ</he> when she cleanses her hair.
